Operational definition: Gases, sectors, organisational boundaries, facility perimeter and Scope 1/2/3 coverage.
Documentary evidence required: Explicit boundary, gas/sector coverage, consolidation or facility-perimeter rules.

Operational definition: Activity data, metering, direct measurement, equations, tiers and calculation procedures.
Documentary evidence required: Measurement rules, activity-data requirements, formulas, tier logic and sampling.

Operational definition: Official national, sector, fuel and electricity factors and procedures for updating them.
Documentary evidence required: Official factor lists, grid factors, default factors, versioning and revisions.

Operational definition: Completeness, consistency, uncertainty, recalculation, record retention and audit trail.
Documentary evidence required: QA/QC plans, uncertainty analysis, recalculation rules and data-quality controls.

Operational definition: Reporting templates, frequency, responsibilities, filing routes and disclosure requirements.
Documentary evidence required: Statutory reports, inventory tables, templates, filing deadlines and disclosure rules.

Operational definition: Independent verification/assurance, reviewer competence, accreditation and independence.
Documentary evidence required: Verification protocols, assurance requirements and accredited verifier arrangements.

Operational definition: Electronic filing, databases, registries, traceability and system interoperability.
Documentary evidence required: Digital portals, registry functions, linked databases and data exchange.

Operational definition: Mandates, coordination, enforcement, review and use of verified carbon data in policy/compliance.
Documentary evidence required: Defined institutional roles, enforcement, compliance use, carbon pricing and feedback.
